notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least four cards this turn.
description:
Cast Grave Sifter for its evoke cost by paying {0} due to Heliod
When Grave Sifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Grave Sifter.
When Grave Sifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Grave Sifter with haste.
When the Grave Sifter token enters, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse
